visual_prompt_en: One clean bright white child T-shirt laid flat, short sleeves and round neckline. Cool light gray shadows only; smooth unmarked fabric, no yellow or brown stains.
One modern unused white disposable baby diaper, open leg holes, elastic waistband and two visible fastening tabs. Clean white absorbent material with subtle pale blue details. No baby or stains.
One blue padded winter overall: a single connected garment with hood, sleeves, waist and two legs. Continuous front zipper joins torso to trousers. No separate jacket or separate trousers.
A matching pair of modern indoor preschool sandals, open toes, molded cork footbeds, heel straps and two broad blue adjustable straps. No boots, slippers or feet.
One clean pale blue duvet, thick soft rectangular bedding with smooth continuous fabric and one folded corner revealing white lining. No stains, bed or decorative patterns.
One clean modern child bed in pale birch with a bright white mattress, light blue fitted sheet and white pillow. Clear bed frame and four legs; no room, stains or people.
One clean light blue rectangular bed pillow with soft filled volume and visible edge seam. Smooth fresh fabric and cool gentle shading, no speckles, stains or pillow pile.
One clean folded sage green fabric blanket with a single corner turned over. Thin soft textile, neat hem, smooth even color; no stains, brown mottling or bed.

One preschool child listening attentively: head slightly turned, one open palm cupped BEHIND one ear, fingers pointing up. Ear canal visibly unobstructed, calm open eyes. Other hand lowered. No hands covering ears.

Close view of a child cutting a plain blue paper sheet with rounded safety scissors. Thumb through the small upper loop, middle and ring fingers through the larger lower loop; natural five-finger hand. Other hand supports paper away from blades.
One anatomically clear spider seen from above: two connected body sections and exactly eight legs, four emerging from each side of the front section. No antennae, wings, web or extra legs.
One ant seen from above: head with two antennae, middle thorax and rounded abdomen. Exactly six legs, three on each side of the thorax. No extra legs, wings or spider shape.
One ordinary interior door: a single rectangular wooden door leaf, slightly open inside one door frame, with one metal lever handle and hinges on one side. No second leaf or mirrored door.
Three unpeeled potatoes, irregular oval shapes with tan brown skin, shallow small eyes and subtle earthy texture. Clearly potatoes rather than smooth white eggs. No basket, plate or foliage.

One modern Swedish ambulance in side view: bright yellow van body, green reflective checker markings, blue emergency lights on roof, two visible wheels, rear patient compartment. No lettering, logos, red cross or people.

A small group of colorful plastic fuse beads used in preschool crafts: short hollow cylinders with large visible circular holes, flat ends and equal heights. Red, blue, yellow and green. No wooden round beads or string.
Two flat rectangular Swedish wholegrain crispbread pieces, brown rye color, rough grain texture and regularly spaced small dimples. Thin crisp edges; no sandwich toppings, soft bread or crackers.

One ordinary toothpaste squeeze tube with a white plastic screw cap and flattened sealed tail, mostly white with simple blue panels. A small stripe of white paste at the open nozzle. No readable text or brand.
One large silver wire paper clip lying flat: continuous bent metal wire with a long outer rounded loop and a smaller nested inner loop, open at one end. No staple, pin, extra clips or paper.

One clearly recognizable child doll with a molded vinyl human face, two arms, two legs, painted open eyes and short hair, wearing a simple blue dress. Visible toy joints; no bear ears, fur or animal face.
